# AI Contribution Policy

Usage of AI to help the development, testing, debugging or any that may apply when working in a contribution for PikiBot is allowed as long
as the author is able to properly understand and explain the code.

## AI when opening an issue, PR, or discussion and communicating with maintainers

When opening a new issue, PR, or discussion, the description and responses are recommended and strongly encouraged to be written in their own words. We, maintainers,
need to make sure we are communicating with the person responsible for the work, and not to an AI tool.

Contributors may use AI tools to properly translate or correct grammar in their own writing, specially when it is a non-native English speaker, as long as
this is disclosed anywhere in any description.
